Coordinate-only symmetric-union k=15 graph with Gaussian distance feature within <=7000-cell tiles. AdamW lr 0.0015, weight decay 0.0001, cosine schedule, gradient clip 5, FP32; 200 epochs, one tile/step, final checkpoint only; seeds 0/1/2. Log1p raw-count Huber delta 1 on hidden entries. Hide all 1000 genes in 10% of cells per core. Masks renewed each epoch.
rows.performance: Own training-mask evaluation: Huber 0.038705, MSE 0.079474, MAE 0.148733, R2 0.2036, pooled/gene/cell Pearson 0.4437 / 0.1479 / 0.4047. Common whole-cell evaluation: Huber 0.038705, MSE 0.079474, MAE 0.148733, pooled/gene/cell Pearson 0.4437 / 0.1479 / 0.4047.
rows.caveats: Transductive fitted-cohort reconstruction on all 246,063 cells / 14 SO2 cores, no donor-held-out split. Three fixed evaluation mask replicates; averages replicates within core, cores equally, then seeds. Training mask schedule shared across seeds. Different evaluation tasks cannot be ranked together. All three runs completed/verified. Whole-cell Huber improves 7.93% over visible-gene-mean baseline in 14/14 cores and 3/3 seeds; zero predictor has better MAE. Does not establish biological mechanism or patient generalization.
